report.explanation: All current read-only telemetry is healthy and contradicts the alert of degraded checkout health: order checkout span OK at 68ms, error rates ~0.14%, p95 78ms, no dependency timeouts or pool waiters, and INFO 200 logs. No public cause is supported. The payment deployment record proves only version facts, not causation. Handing off for human review; no bounded root cause can be established from current evidence.
missing_evidence: No telemetry shows degraded checkout: order trace OK (68ms), gateway/order/payment error_rate 0.0014, p95 78ms, zero dependency timeouts.
No evidence of HTTP 500s, DB pool exhaustion, Redis timeouts, downstream latency, memory leak, or bad configuration.
Payment deployment record (3.0.4, 488 min old, config valid) cannot establish deployment-caused latency.
